caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with an upholstered seat. The chair has four straight, slightly tapered legs, each decorated with a carved pattern resembling leaves. The seat is cushioned and covered in a red fabric with horizontal stripes. The backrest curves gently outward at the sides and features a carved wooden panel. The central motif of the backrest panel is an eagle with outstretched wings, perched and facing forward. The wood of the chair appears to be a brown color with visible grain and carved detailing. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no other objects present. The artist's name, "John Dana," is written in small letters in the lower left corner.
title: Side Chair
